message.content:
I recall a CBP ruling on Quorn products (mycoprotein), which classified them in 2106.90. Mycoprotein is fungal-derived, and the products are food preparations not elsewhere specified. The likely subheading is 2106.90.99 (other food preparations), and the 10-digit code would be 2106.90.9998 (other, not elsewhere specified).

Considerations: the products contain egg white, which is a binder. Under 2106.90, the sub-breakouts include items containing butterfat, sugar and so on. The Quorn Pesto Mozzarella Cutlets contain cheese, which could push them into the dairy-containing subheadings, but the ChiQin Fillets are plain. For those, 2106.90.9998 is the likely outcome.
